terms: The Foundation Edition is a six-month pilot for Greater Toronto Area businesses. Future editions run for one year; ended editions are archived and remain available to view.

Listings are Free, or Membership and verification at $199 for the Foundation Edition, a six-month pilot limited to 100 memberships (CAD, shown before tax; no HST is charged). The Verified badge is an identity badge only. Future editions run for one year; ended editions are archived and remain available to view. The only optional upgrade at launch is a standard ad landing page with a photo (price on enquiry). No bundles or founding discounts. Print ads are not being sold during the Foundation Edition; the printed directory is released after 100 memberships are confirmed and mailed to businesses.

Verified Kabayan badge: payment never buys the badge. The badge certifies identity only (owner identity + business licence or registration). Verified listings are only eligible; the badge is earned on a ~15-minute live video check (owner on camera, ID viewed and never stored, business licence or registration checked, a live premises walkthrough or screen-share, one proof of trading). ID is viewed, never stored. Verification is online only. We may withhold the badge if a check fails; the Verified listing continues without it.
Free listings are unverified: name and contact only, with no badge. Inclusion of a membership card and listing QR code in the membership package is to be confirmed.
Keeping your badge — renewal by issue: the badge stays while your Verified listing is renewed each issue. A light re-check at renewal updates the “Verified [date]”.
Keeping your badge — current details: contact details must stay current. A dead phone number or a closed business pauses the badge.
Keeping your badge — renewal: if you don't renew, the badge is removed and the listing drops to a Free listing.
Keeping your badge — complaints: a complaint pauses the badge pending review. Paused badges are not shown.
QR codes always resolve through pinoypages.ca. Our pages never ask for a login, a payment or personal information.
Landing-page upgrade: an optional standard ad landing page with one photo. Pricing is to be confirmed.
No guarantee of results: we do not promise any number of leads, calls, sales or visitors.

Once 100 memberships are confirmed, the printed Foundation directory will be released and mailed to businesses. Print date and quantity are to be confirmed. Existing print-ad refund term (draft): If it does not print, print ad fees are refunded.
Prices are in CAD and shown before tax. No HST is charged. Draft terms, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
